text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. While walking along the 
tree-lined path back to my room—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugyaaaaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Dammiiiit~... Failed again-noda~~...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh! My future underling, you came at just 
the right time! Help me practice at the 
gate!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wondering if that scream earlier was just 
her struggling with training, I decided to 
help her out, but—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Got that!? Once Windy-chan gets in the 
gate, you give the signal to start!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Come on, give the signal! Signal, signal! 
*fidget*... *fidget* *fidget* *fidget*—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hogya!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Startled by her scream, I rushed over... 
only to find she had dug a deep hole right 
at the starting spot, tripped over it, and 
taken a spectacular spill.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~~... Dammit all~~~!! Why do I always 
trip every single time-noda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And after I built up all that *fidgety* 
power, it's totally wasted-noda--!!
choice_data_list: Maybe all that fidgeting is the problem...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No way! Fidgeting is proof that I'm fired 
up and ready to go! Besides... it gives me 
an awesome start too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And while everyone's watching like 
"Whoa!", I chomp down 1st place... How's 
that, perfect, right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, fighting spirit is necessary for 
racing. However, if she gouges out the 
ground while fidgeting and trips... she 
won't even be able to get a proper start.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I need to reframe this for her with the 
right words.
choice_data_list: Are you really fine with that?
Are you sure you're okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-What! What are you trying to 
say-noda!
choice_data_list:
That fighting spirit shines brightest out 
on the track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
People are suckers for a good gap in 
expectations. Stay calm at first, then 
unleash that fighting spirit on the 
course. I told her that would look way 
cooler.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Fighting spirit... looking cool.........

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That girl over there is surprisingly 
quiet. Maybe she's nervous?

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And the gates burst open! Who will be the 
first to make a move—!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Haaaa~~! FIGHTING SPIRIIIIIT!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
What is that fighting spirit! Is that 
really the same girl from before!? So 
cool--!! Incredible--!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hehehe, well I guess I have no choice~ 
If you insist that much, I'll give it a 
shot!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Alriiiight... I'm in the gate. Even if I 
get fidgety, hold it in... hold it 
iiiinnn~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Uryaaaaa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I didn't trip! Hey hey! How did my 
run look!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nihehe... I like this training! Let's do 
more and more, like 100 times!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm gonna show you even more of 
Windy-chan looking cool-noda! Rejoice!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Won over by her delighted smile, I 
ended up keeping her company until she was 
fully satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugyaaaaah--!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Uuu... uuuu...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine, but... I'll let you off... 
with this much... for 
todaaaay~~~~...-noda!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Overwhelmed by the pain, she ran off in 
tears.
